title: Forma：同一份数据，三种决策方式
Forma: one dataset, three ways to decide
summary: 同一周的增长数据，分别先放大异常、并排比较渠道，或展开证据。
The same week of growth data, leading with the signal, a channel comparison or the evidence.
brief: 为一个虚构的增长分析产品设计每周概览，帮助团队判断本周该关注什么。
Design a weekly overview for a fictional growth analytics product that helps a team decide what needs attention.

optimizes: 先把最需要处理的异常放大。
Surface the one signal that needs action first.
tradeoff: 渠道之间的横向比较要往下看。
Comparing channels side by side takes scrolling.
bestFor: 每周例会前快速判断问题的人。
People triaging before the weekly meeting.

alt: 累计收入趋势，旁边标出需要关注的渠道
Cumulative revenue trend beside the channel that needs attention

optimizes: 把三个渠道并排，差异一眼可见。
Put the three channels side by side so differences are obvious.

alt: 三个渠道卡片并排，各带趋势线
Three channel cards side by side, each with a trend line

optimizes: 选一个渠道就能看到它的明细和数据来源，方便核对。
Pick a channel to see its figures and data source, ready to check.
tradeoff: The conclusion is not visible at a glance.
bestFor: 需要核对数字再做决定的分析师。
Analysts who verify numbers before deciding.

alt: 渠道列表与选中渠道的明细记录
Channel list with the selected channel's record
